R6-02.text:
R6-02 角色药停误阻止护士书写
失败：角色实际吞服→精神扣20、停顿1500ms→在场且目击吞服的护士无法完成记录。
修订：角色身体限制只挡角色动作；护士自己的已合法书写仍能完成。暂停/死亡及护士缺席继续阻断。
依据：S3:T22、P703/P708-709，S4:T16/P189-192。

R6-04.text:
R6-04 隔室接取或拒绝未持有的药杯
失败：药师在治疗室配杯→角色离室→远处调用接杯/拒杯仍成功。
修订：准备好的杯子绑定实际位置；未接杯留在原处，已经持杯才随角色移动。中断后沿用同一杯，不补刷。
依据：S3:P703/P708/P726，S3:P18/P23，S4:P190。

unknown_original_fields.policy: Original unknown fields are not assigned fabricated glyphs; null is not equality evidence.

native_interface_review.review: One autonomous follow-up remains available after the actual answer. Legal CONTROL desk0/nurse-body input consumes interaction.pos array, selects a walkable visible 0.6m stand, routes and dispatches registration_followup to begin. Cancellation does not recurse back to app.cancel_asylum_read. Writing and later reading settle separately.

Available physical target, same room, contact, clear segment and unchanged document revision precede the timed completion. Prior document versions survive. Cuff correspondence needs cuff_seam; lower label only saves layers_exposed, without null-number equality. target.text is implementation description, not new original dialogue.

Original pharmacy group shares one checks record with corridor entry: three total checks at most, subsequent checks need 20 game seconds and half rate. Linked actors enter at original pharmacy doorway; the same med_nurse walks actual rooms/stairs to duty, not a second identity.

Actual source reading/check, real doors, writing and clipping precede public rows. Source identity/attempt/snapshot remains and copies never become own swallowing witness or repeat medicine. Own actual swallow witness queues separate writing. Inherited order selects prescription:+carry.prescription_visit only when it equals carry.visit, not the first historical prescription.

Original copied-error speech requires an actual clipped current-attempt row physically read at the station, exact already-known error source and same nurse onsite. Unknown identifiers do not establish certainty.
